GEO-H1-01.note: Divide by 3, complete squares: (x-2)^2+(y+5)^2=36, r=6; D=36 is r^2.

GEO-H1-02.note: Lateral-area ratio 4:9 gives linear 2:3, volume 8:27, so 32 -> 108.

GEO-H1-03.note: Labels sit on the correct sub-segments (8 on AD, 12 on DB, 10 on DE); AB/AD=20/8=2.5 so BC=25. SVG proportions match: D is at 40% of AB and DE/BC=112/280=0.4.

GEO-H1-04.note: cos A=12/13 with AC=36 gives AB=39, BC=15; C=39 is the hypotenuse.

GEO-H1-05.note: (y-2)^2=64 gives y=10 or y=-6; -6 is deliberately absent and 6 is the sign trap.

GEO-H1-06.note: Arc 6π over 40 deg gives r=27, sector area 81π. SVG sector spans ~40 deg, consistent with the label.

GEO-H1-07.note: 120x80x50=480,000 cm^3=480 L; distractors are only decimal shifts.

GEO-H1-09.note: DEFECT: the label 41 is placed at (198,146), between the dashed OP segment (y~131 there) and tangent PB (y~158), so it can be read as either. Read as OP: PA=40 and area=360 (B). Read as the tangent length PB=41: area=2*(1/2*9*41)=369, which is option C exactly. The ambiguity lands on a listed option.

GEO-H1-10.note: Offset (14-8)/2=3 with leg 5 gives height 4, area 44. SVG is to scale: 18.6 px per unit for both bases, height 74.4 px = 4, legs 93 px = 5.

GEO-H1-11.note: Third side strictly between 5 and 23, so 28 < P < 46; only 28 fails (degenerate).

GEO-H1-14.note: (10/15)^3 = 8/27; the water forms a similar cone because the vertex points down.

GEO-H1-15.note: Both labels sit interior and on the right of the transversal (one below l, one above m), so the angles are co-interior: 8x-20=180, x=25. The equal reading giving 20 is a misread, not a defensible alternative.

GEO-H1-16.note: Both acute, so complementary: 4x+30=90, x=15 (angles 55 and 35).

GEO-H1-18.note: 144π / (32π/3) = 13.5, so 13 whole spheres; 14 is the rounding trap.

GEO-H1-19.note: Center (3,-4), r=5; y=0 gives x=0 and x=6, distance 6.

GEO-H1-20.note: sqrt(36+64+576)=26; A is the 6-8 face diagonal, B and C are filler.

GEO-H1-21.note: FIGURE/STEM MISMATCH: angle B + angle D = 180 gives y = 85, but the drawn quadrilateral (all four vertices genuinely on the circle) has angle B ~= 75 and angle D ~= 105 - and 102 is distractor C, so the drawing points at the trap. The 'Figure not drawn to scale' caveat covers it, but the vertices should be moved to match 78 and 95.

GEO-H1-22.note: π(144-100)=44π; 144π is the outer disc, 4π the width squared.

GEO-H1-23.note: r=17, sin=y/r=15/17; the negative sign belongs to cosine here.

GEO-H1-24.note: 248 - 2π + 8π = 266.85 -> 267; B ignores the hole, A only subtracts, D only adds.
